description: This file implements the LanguageService interface, providing methods to retrieve language information, convert between Language objects and Locale, and manage language data caching within the application.

classes.name: LanguageServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that handles operations related to Language entities, including retrieval by code, conversions with Locale, and cache management.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Language object by its unique code.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Converts a Language object to a Java Locale object.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Converts a Locale object to a Language object based on language code matching.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of language codes to Language objects, rebuilding the map from the cached list.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Fetches the list of all Language objects, utilizing caching to optimize performance.
